newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil cenbank mum on rating upgrade speculation.
newsitem.headline: Brazil cenbank mum on rating upgrade speculation.

text.p: The Brazilian Central Bank declined to comment on market talk it was angling for a rating upgrade or on a newspaper report it could chose a lead manager Wednesday for a potential "Yankee" bond issue.
Brazilian paper was higher in London on speculation Brazil was delaying an expected $750 million to $1.0 billion global or Eurobond issue because of possibility of an upgrade.
Both Moody's and Standard & Poor's declined to comment.
Brazil's Globo newspaper, citing unnamed sources, reported the Central Bank might announce Wednesday or Thursday who it had chosen to place a future Yankee bond in the U.S. market.
